# Gamify

> Gamify turns a teacher's own question sets into classroom games (K-12 and homeschool). Students join with a code or link from their teacher; there are no student accounts, ads or trackers on student pages.

Gamify is made for live classrooms on iPads, Chromebooks, laptops and the big screen. Teachers write or import questions, pick a game, and play it four ways: Share (one big screen, teams take turns), Live (every student on their own device), Solo (practice or homework links) and Versus (two players head to head). Classes can design a theme for any game in the Theme Builder.

## Games
- Game Show: answer right to pick a card; some cards hide power-ups.
- Board Game: answer right, roll the die and race to the finish.
- Match Three: swap pieces to make rows of 3; answer questions to keep playing.
- Four in a Row: answer right, then drop your piece; get four in a row.
- Bubble Pop: answer questions to load bubbles, then aim and match 3 to pop.
- Bowling: answer right, then aim and send the ball into the pins.
- Question Tracker: every right answer adds an object until the screen is full.
